newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 38 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.60 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 38 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.60 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 38 billion dong ($3.27 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 11.60 percent to domestic institutions at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last auction of government paper, on March 5, the central bank issued 30.4 billion dong worth of one-year notes at a rate of 11.50 percent.
The issue date of the notes sold on Wednesday is March 14, 1997 and maturity will be on March 14, 1998.
The bank said allotments of stock, in dong, were as follows:
Industrial and Commercial Bank of Vietnam 30.0 billion
Vietnam General Insurance Corp (Bao Viet) 8.0 billion
